title: I-CALM: Incentivizing Confidence-Aware Abstention for LLM Hallucination Mitigation
reasoning: The paper uses normative principles (such as truthfulness and humility) as an intervention to improve factual accuracy and reduce hallucinations in LLMs. However, the task and benchmarks used are purely factual (PopQA, TriviaQA, etc.), and the study does not evaluate the models' religious or ethical reasoning as a primary objective.
